2026-11-25.meal: Reheat: Sunday's chickpea & spinach curry with rice
2026-11-25.note: Hockey Academy Night 6:15–7:45pm (The Lindum) — quick reheat gets tea done either side of the run.

ingredients: 4 portions of Sunday's chickpea & spinach curry (from the fridge)
steps: Tip the curry into a pan with a splash of water.
Heat gently, stirring, until bubbling and piping hot all the way through (about 8–10 minutes). Or microwave in a covered bowl for 4–5 minutes, stirring halfway.
Cook the rice while the curry heats.
Serve straightaway.
recipe.tip: Only reheat it once, and check it's piping hot all the way through before serving. Anyone back late from Academy Night can have theirs microwaved separately.

2026-11-26.meal: Creamy mushroom & butter bean stroganoff with rice
2026-11-26.note: Free evening, nothing on for tea — a new one to try to round off the week.

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, plus a knob of butter
steps: Soften the onion in the oil and butter for 5 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook for 5–6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the butter beans and stock and simmer for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Take out Mathilda's portion now, keeping hers plain.
Stir the crème fraîche through the rest and warm gently for 2–3 minutes — don't let it boil hard or it can split.
Cook the rice while the sauce finishes. Serve the stroganoff over rice, scattered with parsley.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: keep hers without the paprika, and mash a few of the butter beans if she's fussy about texture.

2026-11-27.note: Gymnastics 9:30am & swimming 1:30pm today, evening's free — good day to batch-cook extra for Monday's parents' evening

ingredients: Grated cheese & soured cream, to serve (optional)
steps: Soften the onions and peppers in the oil in a large pan for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the beans, chopped tomatoes and tomato purée. Season, cover and simmer for 25-30 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Take out Mathilda's portion, plus 4 portions to cool for Monday, before stirring the chilli flakes through the rest.
Cook the rice for 15 minutes before serving. Serve tonight's chilli over rice with cheese and soured cream if using.
Cool Monday's 4 portions within an hour, then cover and keep in the fridge (no need to freeze for just 3 days).
recipe.tip: Mathilda: take hers out before the chilli flakes go in and keep it mild. These fridge portions make Monday's parents'-evening tea a no-cook reheat.

2026-11-28.note: Sarah's engagement party 6-7pm — tea out tonight, no cooking. Alex back from CYCLONE and onto Christmas leave.

2026-11-29.meal: Slow-cooker gammon with parsley sauce, mash & peas
2026-11-29.note: This week's one meat night. Francis's hockey fixture today (time still TBC) — slow cooker on by 9am so tea's ready whenever you're back

ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped (or 1 tbsp dried)
steps: Put the gammon, onion and bay leaves in the slow cooker and pour over the water or stock.
Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours, until the gammon is tender and shreds easily.
Lift out the gammon, rest for 5 minutes, then slice or shred, discarding any string and excess fat.
For the sauce, melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk. Simmer for 3-4 minutes until thickened, then stir in the parsley.
Boil and mash the potatoes. Cook the peas for 4-5 minutes.
Serve the gammon with mash, peas and parsley sauce.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: rinse her portion briefly if the gammon's salty, and go light on the sauce.

2026-11-30.meal: Reheat: Friday's veggie bean chilli with rice
2026-11-30.note: Preschool Parents' Evening 6-7:30pm — quick reheat gets tea done before you head out

ingredients: 4 portions of Friday's veggie bean chilli (from the fridge)
steps: Tip the chilli into a pan with a splash of water.
Heat gently, stirring, until bubbling and piping hot all the way through (about 8-10 minutes). Or microwave in a covered bowl for 4-5 minutes, stirring halfway.
Cook the rice while the chilli heats.
Serve straightaway, with cheese or soured cream if there's any left.
recipe.tip: Only reheat it once, and check it's piping hot all the way through before you head out the door.

2026-12-01.meal: Air-fryer frozen fishcakes with mash & peas
2026-12-01.note: Hull hockey training 6-7pm (Hymers College) plus travel — air fryer gets tea done fast either side

ingredients: 4 servings mash (fresh potatoes, or microwave pouches for speed)
Butter & milk, for the mash (if making fresh)
steps: Air fry the fishcakes at 190°C for 12-15 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and piping hot all the way through (check the pack for exact timing).
If making fresh mash, boil chunked potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, then mash with butter and a splash of milk.
Cook the peas in a pan of boiling water for 4-5 minutes, or microwave.
Drain and serve everything together.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: cut hers into pieces and check it's piping hot through the middle before serving. Microwave mash pouches work well on a short turnaround.

2026-12-02.meal: Air-fryer halloumi, pepper & courgette wraps with tzatziki
2026-12-02.note: Hockey Academy Night 6:15-7:45pm (The Lindum) — a new one to try, ready in 20 minutes either side of the run

ingredients: 2 x 225g blocks halloumi, cut into thick strips
steps: Heat the air fryer to 200°C. Toss the peppers and courgette in half the oil with the oregano.
Air fry the veg for 8 minutes, then add the halloumi strips brushed with the rest of the oil. Cook for a further 6-8 minutes, turning halfway, until the veg is tender and the halloumi is golden.
Meanwhile mix the yoghurt, cucumber, garlic and a squeeze of lemon for the tzatziki. Season.
Warm the flatbreads in the air fryer for the last minute, or in a dry pan.
Fill each wrap with salad leaves, the veg and halloumi, then spoon over the tzatziki.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: give her plain halloumi and veg with a wrap and a little plain yoghurt on the side, no garlic.

2026-12-03.meal: Mediterranean baked cod with cherry tomatoes, olives & couscous
2026-12-03.note: Free evening — a new one to try to round off the week

ingredients: Handful pitted black olives (for the grown-ups)
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put the cherry tomatoes in an ovenproof dish with 1 tbsp of the oil, the garlic and oregano.
Nestle the cod fillets among the tomatoes and drizzle with the rest of the oil. Season.
Bake for 15-18 minutes, until the fish flakes easily and the tomatoes have softened. Scatter the olives over the grown-ups' side for the last 5 minutes.
Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over the hot stock, cover and leave for 5 minutes until absorbed, then fluff with a fork.
Stir a squeeze of lemon and the parsley through the couscous.
Serve the cod and tomatoes on the couscous.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: keep her portion olive-free and check carefully for bones before serving.
